lambda_finding.mechanical_cause: DESIGN LIMITATION of this harness iteration: lambda was initialized at exactly 0 and the routing-query gradient is proportional to lambda (ds/dW_r ~ lambda), so W_r receives zero gradient until lambda escapes 0 -- a chicken-and-egg lock. Profile-aware ROUTING therefore never substantively engaged; the accuracy gains came from the candidate-grounding repair.
lambda_finding.disposition: recorded as a limitation, NOT relaunched in this round (stop law: no result-driven changes after P1 began). A lambda>0 initialization (or no gating scalar) is the documented fix for a future owner-authorized iteration.
lambda_finding.descriptive_note: S3 being the only arm whose lambda escaped zero in 2/3 seeds is directionally consistent with the CAS profile carrying some routing signal; the accuracy effect is inside seed noise and licenses nothing.
